title: Add live CLI coverage for memory compaction
summary: Exercise memory compaction through a real daemon and CLI subprocess, covering dry-run and apply behavior plus audit evidence for deleted, marked, and detached records.
expectedFailureModes: Compaction passes unit tests but the public CLI cannot submit the policy shape through IPC.
